title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Parameter hint navigation without side effects
summary: Fixes Cmd+Click on parameter inlay hints to navigate directly to the declaration without triggering the Find Usages panel as a side effect.

highlights.title: Parameter Hint Click Fix
highlights.description: Cmd+Click on a parameter inlay hint now navigates cleanly to the parameter declaration — the Find Usages panel no longer opens as an unintended side effect.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Cmd+Click on a parameter inlay hint now performs navigation only — it jumps to the parameter declaration without also opening the Find Usages panel.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: This is a focused single-fix release. No other commands, settings, navigation behavior, or UI changed since v1.17.8.
